name: Greek Chicken Mason Jar "Grain Bowl" with Quinoa, Tomato, Cucumber, Olives & Feta (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Once done, remove quinoa from heat and spread it out on a baking sheet pan to cool, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup quinoa
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and divide between two (quart-sized) jars.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Add to the jars with the dressing.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the jars.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the jars.
Trim and medium dice cucumber. Add to the jars.
Place chicken on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones; separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Add to the jars along with the feta.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
½ (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the quinoa is cooled, add to the jars, packing lightly if necessary.
Screw lids onto jars and store in the fridge until needed. (Best if used within 2-3 days.)
When ready to eat, empty jar into a bowl (making sure to scrape out all of the dressing!), then stir to combine. Enjoy!
